findings.description: [defect] In the desktop Priority Triage section (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png), the two incident cards have unequal widths (~58% vs ~42%) that do not align with the 6-column KPI grid above, causing the right-hand search-indexer card to wrap "budget left 62%" onto a second metric line while checkout-api keeps all metrics inline.
[defect] In the mobile top view (02-mobile-top.png), the checkout-api incident metric wraps mid-parenthetical between "(+362" and "ms)", leaving an orphaned unit on the next line.

[defect] In the Last 24 Hours latency chart (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png), the Y-axis uses non-round decimal ticks (168.3, 336.6, 504.9, 673.2) rather than clean rounded intervals, reducing scannability.

[suggestion] In the desktop Service SLO Health section (01-desktop-full.png), the top-aligned detail card in the right column leaves empty background space beside the lower service list rows; balancing column heights or adding secondary context could tighten the composition.

verdict.summary: Approved for the reviewed desktop and mobile screenshots. The Fleet Dashboard has clean outer key-line alignment, strong visual hierarchy across triage, chart, SLO health, runner pools, and recent deploys, no overlapping or occluded content, and a responsive mobile layout. Only minor wrapping and chart tick-formatting polish items were observed, with no critical or major defects.
